LESSON: COOKING: PREPARING A BALANCED MEAL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.6: Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal, part of Food Production Processes in Grade 8 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we prepare a balanced meal for healthy living?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain factors to consider in preparing a balanced meal,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. prepare a balanced meal for healthy living,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. use various styles to present the meal,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. adopt the use of a balanced meal in the day to day life. Learners are guided to: • discuss and share experiences on factors to consider in preparing a balanced meal such as age, health status, occasion and gender, • plan and cook a balanced meal that include proteins, carbohydrate, vitamins and minerals, • serve the balanced meal using appropriate serving styles such as family or blue plate to present the meal, • make various menus on balanced meal and present in class. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: networking skills as learners share new ideas that inspire creative thinking in preparing and

presenting meals.

Values:
Integrity: prudent use of resources in the preparation of balanced meal.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health promotion as learners adopt the use of balanced meal in day to day life.

Link to other learning areas:

Learners relate consumption of balanced meal to prevention of lifestyle diseases learnt in Integrated Science.
